takes.situation: Zhou won't take vague money again and makes the Fixer spell out the job, term by term.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Seventy thousand. Last vague money cost me. Spell the job out.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Have you eaten today? You haggle like you haven't.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: No. Pay card came back stamped short. Chime goes, then what?

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Drive the Councillor round to the service bay, east yard. Not home.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: And wait there? A couple of minutes, then I drive on.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: We'll be there. We get him out of the back seat.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Won't ask who "we" is. Can't sell what I don't know.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: It's paid already, Zhou. I'd hate to have paid for nothing.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Anyone watching my bay, I send off. The rest I don't see.

learned: Vale's driver Zhou: short, now paid.

takes.situation: Zhou opens high and loses on price, so the fun moves to itemising what seventy thousand buys.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Eighty thousand. The Councillor's driver doesn't come cheap.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Seventy. I hear the clockwork collector's called on you twice this month.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Very politely. "Kindly settle, kindly settle." Seventy, then. For what, exactly?

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: The Councillor gets in at the chime. Service bay, not home.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: East yard. I wait a couple of minutes, then I drive on.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Plenty. We get him out of the back seat. It's paid.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Who "we" is, I won't ask. Then I've nothing to tell.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: You're wasted on a front seat, Zhou. I mean that.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Anyone watching my bay, I send off. Free. Then I don't look.

learned: Zhou, Vale's driver, took the money.

takes.situation: The Fixer pays before saying what for, and Zhou, suspicious of early money, makes the terms afterwards.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: It's paid, Zhou. Seventy thousand, and you haven't heard the job.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: My wages come down the tube late and thin. Nobody pays first.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: We do. You're the only honest person on Apron Road, Zhou.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Honest is extra. I've been paid for "small favours". What, exactly?

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: At the chime, take the Councillor to the service bay. Not home.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: East yard. A couple of minutes, then I drive on.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Long enough. We get him out of the back seat.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: I don't ask who "we" is. I asked once. Money stopped.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: I send off anyone watching my bay. I never saw the rest.

learned: Paid: Vale's car waits out back.
